title: Godot 4.4 (C#/Mono) Android game exports sometimes crash during startup on Meta Quest 2/3
body:
### Tested versions


# Tested on Godot versions
Did a "binary search" to figure out the version which introduced the issue. It seems to be `4.4-dev3_mono` based on my tests. Here is an overview of the editors tested:
- v4.4-stable_mono_win64 (with godotxrvendors v3.1.2) -bad
- v4.4-stable_mono_win64 (with godotxrvendors v4.0.0-beta1) - bad
- v4.4-rc3_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.4-rc2_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.4-rc1_mono_win64 (with godotxrvendors v4.0.0-beta1) - bad
- v4.4-beta4_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.4-beta3_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.4-beta2_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.4-beta1_mono_win64 (with godotxrvendors v4.0.0-beta1) -bad
- v4.4-dev7_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.4-dev6_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.4-dev5_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.4-dev4_mono_win64 (with godotxrvendors v3.1.2) -bad
- v4.4-dev3_mono_win64 (with godotxrvendors v3.1.2) - bad <-- (First bad version)
- v4.4-dev2_mono_win64 (with godotxrvendors v3.1.2) -good
- v4.4-dev1_mono_win64 - not tested
- v4.3-stable_mono_win64 (with godotxrvendors v3.1.2) - good


### System information

Built from Windows 11, tested thoroughly on Quest 2 (and reproduced on 3). Godot versions in description.

### Issue description

# Description
Games built for android and running on Meta Quest crashes sometimes at startup. Tested on Quest 2 and 3
Reproducible with a minimal setup, described below.
This only seems to happen if the project is using C#


### Steps to reproduce


# Development environment
- OpenJDK 17 (as recommended in docs)
- Android SDK setup (also from docs): `sdkmanager --sdk_root=<android_sdk_path> "platform-tools" "build-tools;34.0.0" "platforms;android-34" "cmdline-tools;latest" "cmake;3.10.2.4988404" "ndk;23.2.8568313"`

# Project setup
These are the steps I followed to reproduce the problem for each godot version:
- [ ] *Create new project in the Godot mono version*
- [ ] *Install Godot XR Vendors plugin v3.1.2*
- [ ] *Add export preset*
	- [ ] *Set texture compression as suggested*
	- [ ] *Use gradle build*
	- [ ] *Use meta quest plugin*
	- [ ] *Use OpenXR*
	- [ ] *Set package name*
- [ ] *Add android build template*
- [ ] *Project settings - enable OpenXR*
- [ ] *Project settings -Enable shaders*
- [ ] *Add XR setup to main scene*
- [ ] *Add meshes to hands*
- [ ] *Add env and light*
- [ ] *Add XR init script*
- [ ] *Set main scene*
- [ ] *Add C# solution*
- [ ] *Add C# script*
- [ ] *Make sure C# solution builds*
- [ ] *Export, Install to quest 2 or 3 and Run*
